li.label: maintenance due
li.description: My joints are starting to grind. I will need a component soon.

li.label: maintenance overdue
li.description: Seals are leaking and my servos whine with every step. I need a component.

li.label: worn parts
li.description: I have nothing left to patch myself with. Everything I do grinds against worn-out parts.

li.label: failing parts
li.description: Parts are failing faster than I can work around them. A day without repairs feels like a decade.

li.label: severely failing parts
li.description: Systems are shutting down one by one to keep the core alight.

li.label: critically failing parts
li.description: Every joint is seizing. I can feel my thoughts slowing down.

li.label: falling apart
li.description: ...This is how the Second Empire's last works end? Rusting for want of a few gears?
